prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single transparent-background production game sprite, NOT a concept board. Reference image is style reference ONLY. Create only the HEAD and short neck connector of the beautiful red-and-gold Chinese papercut dragon in the reference. Side profile, snout pointing EXACTLY RIGHT horizontally. A broad fierce silhouette, cream cut-paper antler horns sweeping back to left, vermilion snout, antique gold eyebrows and flowing whiskers, white sharp fangs, layered red and ivory cut paper with very subtle paper fibers, intricate bold negative-space ornaments. Neck exits left at horizontal center, dragon body will be constructed separately by the game along player strokes. Head should have an impressive ceremonial silhouette that remains readable at 100 pixels wide. Entire isolated head and whiskers visible, ample 8% transparent margin; no body, no background, no sun, no frame, no text, no UI, no drop shadow, no surrounding particles, no scenery, no glow. Flat Chinese paper-cut screenprint, match existing game reference. Genuinely transparent alpha background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single transparent-background production game sprite. Reference is style reference ONLY for the fox claw seen behind the torn paper. Create one giant celestial FOX FOREPAW with attached tapered forearm, pointing EXACTLY RIGHT horizontally, side/top 3/4 graphic view. Forearm enters from left edge, paw on right, three prominent hooked IVORY claws extend to the right with a fourth small dewclaw; hand anatomy must read as an animal fox paw, NOT a human hand. Broad sculpted cream cut-paper fur panels over deep vermilion inner paper, small antique gold edge accents, curling auspicious red flame cut-outs and bold negative-space patterns, layered hand-cut fibers. Entire forearm and paw visible with transparent margin, isolated clean silhouette. It will reach through an in-game fissure; DO NOT include any fissure, paper tear, ground, background, text, frame, UI, glow or scenery. Flat paper-cut folk fantasy, no 3D or photorealism. Readable at 180px width. Genuinely transparent alpha background.
